gates.name: Test the host
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests requires restoring SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from GitHub Packages in the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository, which needs a cross-repo read:packages credential (NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN, CI's REGISTRY_TOKEN secret). Extracting my own gh auth token to supply that credential locally was blocked by the Claude Code permission classifier as credential handling, and I did not attempt to work around that block. The corresponding CI check on this PR is where the answer comes from; it was already green on the current main HEAD (b16cab8, PR #476's merge) per host-image.yml, and this PR does not touch src/host, Dockerfile, or the workflow.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: Requires building the host container image first, which needs the same cross-repo GitHub Packages credential as "Test the host" above (same reason, not repeated evidence). CI's host-image.yml already ran this gate green on current main HEAD b16cab8, and this PR touches no host/Dockerfile/workflow files.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Depends on the base image built in "Positive route and probe smoke", so it did not run for the same credential reason. CI's host-image.yml already ran this gate green on current main HEAD b16cab8, and this PR touches no host/Dockerfile/workflow files.
